title: 第21章 咱都是一家人第22章 都怪我天性善良
slug: 太古神族第2477章秘境之变
lines: 神丹道古卷上所记录的丹方，莫阳早已经熟记于心了，他才看一眼便认出这确实是阳春丹的丹方。
阳春丹的用途功效很单一，在神丹道古卷中还有另外一种称呼，也称起阳丹。
说简单些就是专门为某些方面不太好使的男人而开创的丹方，此丹药有重振雄风之用。
莫阳看了丹方一眼，随后神色古怪地朝二长老看去。
见莫阳这神色，二长老顿时神色有些发紧，急忙开口问道：“这丹方的丹药，能炼制吗？”
苏菲儿和大长老也都看向莫阳。
只见莫阳正了正色，随后眉头微皱，这才开口说道：“炼制是能炼制，不过我说二长老，你珍藏这丹方十余年，真不知道这丹方是炼制什么丹药的？”
二长老有些茫然的摇头，关于炼丹，不通便是不通，他不曾涉足过丹道，能看懂上面的药材，却无法推断出丹药的用途。
“咳咳！”
莫阳忍住笑意干咳了几声，开口道：“这是阳春丹，还有一个名字叫做起阳！”
二长老朝大长老看了一眼，隐隐间感觉不太对劲，皱眉道：“是否对天玄境修者有用？”
莫阳憋着一肚子笑意，清了清嗓子，点头道：“那是自然，别说天玄境，就算是天玄境之上的宗师境，或是更往上的战王境，服用之后也同样有奇效！”
听莫阳这么说，大长老和二长老皆是面露惊容，同时眼中也浮起一抹欣喜之色。
这丹方居然如此不凡？
苏菲儿很是不解，忍不住朝莫阳问道：“莫阳哥哥，这阳春丹到底是做什么的？真的那么厉害吗？”
“咳咳……能让男人重新站起来，你说厉害不厉害！”当着两位长老的面，莫阳也不好细说。
但大长老和二长老自然瞬间就听明白了，刚才听到丹药的名字时，他们就感觉有些奇怪，此时莫阳这么一说，两人如何还不清楚。
二长老当即老脸一红，不过脸上倒是没有露出失落之色，反而眼中闪烁出一缕精光。
“当真！”他眼中精芒一闪，急忙朝莫阳开口询问。
莫阳似笑非笑的看着二长老，目光意有所指的朝某个地方扫了一眼，开口道：“看来二长老真是年纪大了……”
“呃……咳咳……”二长老当即神色尴尬，忍不住干咳了几声，暗怪自己太心急了。
苏菲儿在一旁满脸茫然，感觉莫阳他们像是在打哑谜一样，完全听不懂。
她心中是真不明白，莫阳说重新站起来，这啥意思？
“菲儿，时间也不早了，你先回去吧，我们和莫阳还有一些话要说！”大长老开口故作平静的开口。
毕竟当着苏菲儿的面，他们也不好多问，只好将苏菲儿支开。
苏菲儿看了看莫阳，又看了看大长老和二长老，带着满脑子的疑惑退出了屋子，口中嘀咕道：“你们不说，我去找徐师姐问清楚！”
两位长老当即脸都黑了，二长老急忙走过去将房门合上，这才压低声音朝莫阳问道：“莫阳，你说的可是真的？”
此时连大长老也露出几分希冀之色，目光灼灼的盯着莫阳。
莫阳看着眼前这两张脸，强行憋住笑意，语重心长的开口道：“自然是真的，不过二长老，您老年纪也大了，应该多加保养，何必在乎那玩意，有些事情顺其自然就行了，焉了就焉了，何必强求。”
还不等二长老开口，大长老便先开口了。
他正色道：“我们身为修者，修炼便是逆天而行，怎么能顺其自然！”
莫阳目光移到大长老身上，似笑非笑的看了大长老一眼。
大长老当即满脸尴尬，他急忙转移话题道：“那我的那副丹方呢，是炼制何种丹药的？”
莫阳摇头道：“我方才看了，这丹方不对，上面的药材属性皆是对立的，也不知大长老是从何处所得，恐怕是被人骗了！”
大长老一听，当即大骂道：“该死，我就说那老家伙怎么会那么好心，二十万银票就肯将丹方卖给我！”
他暗骂了几句，平静后开口朝莫阳问道：“莫阳，以往我们对你有些成见，是我们不对，你别放在心上！”
content_en:
Mo Yang had already memorized the prescriptions recorded in the ancient scrolls of Shendan Dao, and he recognized it at a glance as indeed the recipe for Yangchun Dan.
The use and effect of Yangchun Dan is very single. There is another name in the ancient scrolls of Shendan Dao, also called Yang Dan.
To put it simply, it is an elixir specially created for men who are not easy to use in certain aspects. This elixir can restore their glory.
Mo Yang glanced at Dan Fang, and then looked at the second elder with a strange expression.
Seeing Mo Yang's look, the second elder suddenly became nervous and asked hurriedly: "Can the elixir in this recipe be refined?"
Sophie and the First Elder also looked at Mo Yang.
Mo Yang straightened his expression, then frowned slightly, and then said: "Refining can be done, but let me tell you, Second Elder, you have been collecting this elixir for more than ten years, and you really don't know what kind of elixir is refining this elixir?"
The second elder shook his head in confusion. Regarding alchemy, if you don't understand it, you don't understand it. He has never set foot in the alchemy path. He can understand the medicinal materials on it, but he can't deduce the purpose of the elixir.
"Ahem!"
Mo Yang suppressed his laughter and coughed a few times, then said: "This is Yangchun Pill, and there is another name called Qiyang!"
The second elder glanced at the first elder, feeling vaguely that something was not right, and frowned: "Is it useful to cultivators of the Tianxuan Realm?"
Mo Yang suppressed a smile, cleared his throat, and nodded: "That's natural. Let alone the Sky Profound Realm, even if it is the Grandmaster Realm above the Tian Xuan Realm, or the War King Realm higher up, it will still have miraculous effects after taking it!"
Hearing what Mo Yang said, the first elder and the second elder both looked shocked, and at the same time there was a hint of joy in their eyes.
Is this elixir recipe so extraordinary?
Sophie was very puzzled and couldn't help but ask Mo Yang: "Brother Mo Yang, what does this Yangchun Pill do? Is it really that powerful?"
"Ahem...it can make a man stand up again, do you think it's amazing or not?" In front of the two elders, Mo Yang couldn't elaborate.
But the First Elder and the Second Elder naturally understood it instantly. When they heard the name of the elixir just now, they felt a little strange. When Mo Yang said this, they still didn't know why.
The second elder immediately blushed, but his face did not show a look of disappointment. Instead, there was a ray of light in his eyes.
"Seriously!" His eyes flashed and he hurriedly asked Mo Yang.
Mo Yang looked at the second elder with a half-smile, glanced at a certain place with a pointed look, and said: "It seems that the second elder is really old..."
"Uh... cough..." The second elder immediately looked embarrassed and couldn't help coughing a few times, secretly blaming himself for being too impatient.
Sophie was at a loss and felt as if Mo Yang and the others were playing riddles and couldn't understand it at all.
She really didn't understand, what did Mo Yang mean when he said stand up again?
"Fei'er, it's getting late. You should go back first. We and Mo Yang still have something to say!" The great elder said calmly.
After all, they couldn't ask more questions in front of Sophie, so they had no choice but to push Sophie away.
Sophie looked at Mo Yang, then at the First Elder and the Second Elder, and exited the room with doubts in her mind, muttering in her mouth: "If you don't tell me, I'll go find Senior Sister Xu to find out!"
The faces of the two elders turned dark immediately. The second elder hurriedly walked over and closed the door. Then he lowered his voice and asked Mo Yang: "Mo Yang, are you telling the truth?"
At this time, even the Great Elder showed some hope, staring at Mo Yang with burning eyes.
Mo Yang looked at the two faces in front of him, suppressed his smile, and said earnestly: "Of course it is true, but Second Elder, you are getting older and you should take better care of yourself. Why bother about that thing? Some things can just let nature take its course. It will be done as it is, so why force it."
Before the second elder could speak, the first elder spoke first.
He said seriously: "As cultivators, our cultivation is to go against nature, how can we let nature take its course!"
Mo Yang's eyes moved to the great elder, and he looked at the great elder with a half-smile.
The great elder immediately looked embarrassed. He hurriedly changed the subject and said, "What about my pill recipe? What kind of pill is it made from?"
Mo Yang shook his head and said: "I just looked at it and found that this elixir recipe is wrong. The properties of the medicinal materials on it are all opposite. I don't know where the great elder got it from. I'm afraid he was deceived!"
When the great elder heard this, he immediately cursed: "Damn it, how could that old guy be so kind? He was willing to sell me the elixir recipe for 200,000 yuan!"
He cursed a few words secretly, then calmed down and asked Mo Yang: "Mo Yang, we had some prejudices against you in the past. It's our fault. Don't take it to heart!"
